brief: Asserts that value is dataType unevaluated
description: Returns value unchanged if it is dataType unevaluated. Otherwise, including when value is undefined, throws an error. It never converts: to get a unevaluated from a value of another data type, write a typed literal or call a to_T conversion function where one exists. This is usually written value as unevaluated.

errorsThrown.reason: value is not the asserted data type
